name: Investor / Real Estate Residency

qualifying_event.description: A foreign national who purchases qualifying Jordanian real estate, or holds investor/associate status in a registered company, may apply for Investment/Business Residency; real estate purchase applications must go to the Ministry of Investment within 3 months of the purchase date.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Property title deed or company registration/investor documentation.

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum property value of JOD 150,000 (outside Amman) up to JOD 300,000 (from a non-developer), held for residential purposes only, for at least 5 years without sale or mortgage.
Property must be retained, unmortgaged and unsold, for at least 5 years.
Investor, company owner, or associate status with a valid work license and company registration certificate.

evidence_required.document: Company registration certificate and work license (business route)

outcome.duration_length: real estate route: 5 years; business route: 1 year, renewable

sources.title: Jordan Public Security Directorate (PSD), Borders and Residence Department -- Information Services: Investment/Business Residency, 1-year duration, 30 JOD fee, requires investor/company-owner/associate status with valid work license and company registration

lawjo.net (Jordanian law firm) -- Residency in Jordan for Investors: real estate residency thresholds (JOD 200,000 from a developer / JOD 300,000 from a non-developer / JOD 150,000 outside Amman), 5-year hold, application to Ministry of Investment within 3 months of purchase

Zawya (business news) -- Jordan investor residency/citizenship rules: real estate residency figures (JOD 200,000 from developer / JOD 300,000 non-developer / JOD 150,000 outside Amman, 5-year hold) independently corroborating lawjo.net

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jordan). The JOD 150,000-value requirement modeled here (joir_property_value) uses the lowest confirmed threshold; the actual figure varies by developer status and Amman vs. other-region location per both corroborating sources. pr_after_months mirrors the 10-year cumulative residence figure from jo_permanent_residence.json since no separate investor-specific PR timeline was found.
